text:
oliver: Quick flag for month-end: vendor invoice from NorthGrid BV arrived late (invoice date 2025-04-04) but covers service period 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-31. EUR 39,450. Do we accrue for March?
rachel: Please paste invoice snippet + contract ref. Also need to know if this vendor is passthrough vs platform COGS.
oliver: snippet and contract below - contract ref NG-RES-2022 (billing window 60 days).
```
Invoice: NG-2025-231
Service: Reserved inference capacity - Mar 2025
Invoice date: 2025-04-04
Amount: EUR 39,450 (VAT excl)
Vendor FX on invoice: 1.08 USD/EUR
```
sam: From revenue standpoint, if capacity was delivered to customers in March, revenue stays in March. Costs should match revenue -> accrue. GL suggestion: Debit Hosting COGS (6003), Credit Accrued Expenses (2110).
anita: Agree. Use month-end spot FX per policy. 2025-03-31 spot = 1.10 USD/EUR. That gives accrual USD = 39,450 * 1.10 = 43,395.00 USD. Include both FX rates in workpaper and call out why we use spot at month-end.
oliver: my approval limit is $25k, this is >25k so needs L2. @anita can you approve?
anita: I'll review. Please upload invoice, contract clause, and FX screenshots to binder. Also prepare reversal JE template for April.
sam: Draft JE prepared: JE_2025-03_ACCR_NG-231.xlsx. Description: "Accrual for NorthGrid late invoice; matched to March delivery; spot FX 2025-03-31=1.10"
rev-bot: Month-end binder updated: new file uploaded by sam (JE_2025-03_ACCR_NG-231.xlsx). :white_check_mark:
anita: Reviewed. Approving accrual. JE to debit 6003 USD 43,395.00, credit 2110 USD 43,395.00. Reverse in April when invoice posts.
rachel: Added a one-line note to the close memo explaining vendor billing lag, contract clause, and FX choice per policy. Auditors requested contract clause copy - included.
oliver: JE posted to GL (JE# 2025-03-1199). Reversal template saved as well. Closing this thread for March close.
sam: Thanks team. Closing action: rachel to keep binder notes for audit.
oliver: resolved. :heavy_check_mark:
